waycontext <command> [args...]

Run `waycontext help <command>` for the full description of any command,
or add --debug to any command to see the underlying stack trace on failure.

Inside a repo that has been through `waycontext init`, <project> can be left
off — it is read from CLAUDE.md — and `waycontext index` needs no arguments.

Getting started:
  index_project <project> <path>            index a project: symbols, graph, embeddings (alias: index, reindex)
  list_projects                             what's indexed, with file/symbol counts
  project_overview <project>                orient in an unfamiliar codebase
  search_code <project> <query> [limit]     find code by describing what it does (alias: search)
  init [name] [path] [--yes] [--all]        tell this repo's agents to use WayContext

Search & navigate:
  search_knowledge <project> <query> [limit]
                                            search code and docs together (the 'why') (alias: knowledge)
  get_symbol <project> <name>               full source and signature of one symbol
  get_callers <project> <name>              what references this — the blast radius
  get_callees <project> <name>              what this depends on
  get_graph <project> <name> [depth]        dependency subgraph, both directions
  get_file_outline <project> <path>         every symbol defined in one file
  find_related <project> <name> [limit]     semantically similar symbols

Architecture & history:
  get_history <project> [target] [limit]    commits that touched this, newest first (alias: history)
  who_owns <project> [target] [limit]       who to ask, weighted by recency (alias: owners)
  get_modules <project> [sort] [limit]      modules by risk: churn + defect density (alias: modules)
  get_module <project> <module>             one module: metrics, deps, owners (alias: module)
  get_cochange <project> <target> [limit]   what historically changes alongside this (alias: cochange)
  get_bug_clusters <project> [limit]        what keeps breaking, grouped (alias: bugs)

Rules & engineering memory:
  get_rules <project> [target]              confirmed conventions covering this code (alias: rules)
  remember <project> <content> [kind] [scope] [supersedes] [pinned]
                                            record a gotcha so it outlives the session
  recall <project> <query> [limit]          search what was recorded earlier
  rule candidates [project] [--json]        review extracted rule candidates (human-only, not an MCP tool)
  rule confirm|reject <id> [project]        activate or permanently discard a candidate
  knowledge-export [project]                write .waycontext/knowledge/*.yaml for team sharing
  knowledge-import [project]                read them back (additive: never deactivates a rule)

Context for a task:
  review_context <project> [paths]          what to know before reviewing a change (alias: review)
  compose_context <project> <task> [budget] [format]
                                            rules + code + docs + memory, in one call (alias: context)
  create_reasoning_graph <project> <feature> [slug]
                                            start a decision graph for a feature (alias: reasoning-init)
  update_reasoning_graph <project> <slug> <patch>
                                            patch a decision graph, re-render HTML (alias: reasoning-update)

Setup & administration:
  init-db                                   create the schema (same as migrate)
  migrate [--status]                        apply pending SQL migrations, or just report their state
  backfill-identity [project] [--status] [--json]
                                            give pre-existing symbols stable keys + entities (batched, resumable)
  hook install [--global] [--mode M]        install the opt-in search hook (M: advise|ask|deny, default advise)
  hook uninstall [--global]                 remove the search hook
  hook refresh                              rebuild the hook's project cache from the database
  gate install                              copy the hook script, merge settings.json, merge .gitignore
  gate uninstall                            remove the hook script and its settings.json entries
  uninstall                                 remove the hook, the global CLAUDE.md section and the project cache
  serve [--port=4747] [--host=…]            HTTP API + web knowledge graph on localhost (no auth)
  service ensure [--quiet]                  start or reuse the managed local service
  service status                            show service health, pid and version
  service stop                              stop the managed local background service
  delete_project <project> [--yes]          delete a project and all its indexed data
  stats                                     (alias for list_projects, table output)
  db                                        interactive psql session
  tables [table] [limit]                    list tables, or browse rows of one table (default limit 20)
  usage [project]                           embedding token usage per provider/model, with est. cost if configured
  completion bash|install|uninstall         print or install the bash tab-completion script
  version                                   print the installed version
